title: Google data-connect start request
description: POST /auth/google/connect/start. Authenticated. product is calendar only in calendar.v1 (Docs/Drive get their own contract). The client cannot name scopes. noticeVersion is the id of the DRAFT pre-screen text the student saw; stored with the state row and copied to the grant record and a content-free audit event at the callback (CV-11). DRAFT calendar.v1 (docs/API_CONTRACTS_CALENDAR.md), NOT frozen. Mock and fake-Google only.
